blocks.text:
After breakfast, you can visit Corcovado. An eco-friendly train travels through the Tijuca Forest, home to monkeys, birds and other animals.

At an elevation of around 700 m stands the 38-metre statue of Christ the Redeemer, built in 1931. The viewing platform overlooks the Niterói Bridge, Guanabara Bay, the Botanical Garden, Maracanã Stadium and Sugar Loaf.

The afternoon is free. You can spend it in the city, watch the sunset or choose an optional favela tour with a visit to a local neighbourhood.
